messages:
Nina: apiserver 503 spike in eu-west1, controllers failing lease renewals. p95 latency and watch fanout both spiking. seeing a lot of `context deadline exceeded` in apiserver logs.
ci-bot: [ALERT] apiserver.503_rate spike detected in eu-west1 at 2024-06-12T09:20:34Z
Sam: looking — top source of watches is model-serving fleet (route: /v1/generate). watch connections ~6k, bursty.
Alice: etcd leader (etcd-0) p99 fsync/write latency high, compaction backlog increasing. disk iops showing uneven spikes.
Ben: GPU provisioner backlog jumped to ~1.2k pending pods (ContainerCreating -> waiting for attach). many pods stuck waiting on attach-controller.
Sam: could we throttle the model API at the edge for 10m? or divert traffic to eu-central temporarily.
Nina: planning to roll a 30% traffic shift to eu-central for non-urgent jobs, and add a soft rate-limit on /v1/generate.
Maria: oncall here, approve cross-region shift for low-priority routes for 15m window. keep me posted.
ci-bot: deploy job started: traffic-shift 30% -> eu-central (deploy id: shift-20240612-001)
Alice: quick mitigation idea: remount etcd db on a different NVMe on etcd-0; current disk showing high fsync p99 ~85ms.
Ben: provisioner change queued: prefer nodes with pre-attached GPUs for pending jobs (WIP commit a1b2c3). should lower attach churn.
Sam: controller-manager still logs lease renew failures for kube-controller-manager: "failed to get lease" — probably due to apiserver throttling.
Nina: temporarily bump apiserver client burst for controllers? risky but might buy time. alternative: reduce watch fanout by toggling the feature flag for debug-streamers.
Alice: remounted /mnt/etcd-db on etcd-0 to spare NVMe at 09:24Z, p99 write latency dropped ~60%.
Ben: after traffic shift and provisioner tweak backlog down to ~300 pending. attach time median improved.
Sam: rebalancer job that moves GPUs runs at 01:00 UTC — can we postpone to avoid extra churn?
Nina: yes, rebalancer deferred. adding note to scheduler: hold heavy scheduled jobs for 2 hours.
ci-bot: deploy completed: traffic-shift 30% -> eu-central successful (shift-20240612-001)
Maria: customers? any SLO impact so far?
Nina: no customer-facing errors reported, internal SLOs still green but close to threshold. will follow up with a short incident write-up if we see regressions.
Alice: etcd compaction backlog cleared after remount and leader heap stabilized. continuing to monitor.
Ben: attach backlog drained fully, most pending pods moved to Running by 09:35Z.
Sam: controller-manager lease renew errors reduced after traffic shift and apiserver burst adjustments.
Nina: saving logs and dashboard snapshots to the incident folder, will spin a follow-up in incidents if needed. thanks all for quick responses. :thumbsup:
